ReportProperties.Description: Chancellor Emmerich Hegel publicly commended the recent expulsion of powerful oligarchs in Sordland. Hegel remarked that such actions could pave the way for a more equitable distribution of wealth and power within Sordland, aligning more closely with socialist ideals. The Chancellor expressed hope that this significant step would help to curb the undue influence of a wealthy few, leading to a more balanced society.
ReportProperties.Title: Valgsland Lauds Sordish Oligarch Expulsion

ReportProperties.Description:
After the violent takeover of private camping property by rebels a group of 400 police officers descended upon the camp to dispel the rebels who were found to be armed resulting in a massive firefight. The rebels lost 43 people in the gunfight while the police had 10 killed in action.

The camp was captured but many more police units were wounded during the operations. Two hundred armed rebels surrendered while a few dozen escaped towards Morna and are being searched for.
ReportProperties.Title: Camp Freedom Rebels Clash with Police

ReportProperties.Description: Following our decision to leave the AN, Wehlen has now announced that it is seriously considering its own position, signaling the growing dissatisfaction of disgraced nations with the organization.
ReportProperties.Title: Wehlen Rethinking AN Membership

ReportProperties.Description: Wehlen’s Wiktor Smolak has praised our violent crackdown on protesters, saying we are an example of how to maintain order.
ReportProperties.Title: Wehlen Praises Our Crackdown

ReportProperties.Description: President Wiktor Smolak has accepted our invitation to join talks for a South Merkopan alliance. He will be present at the upcoming roundtable in Porte Drazon.
ReportProperties.Title: Wehlen To Join Regional Alliance Talks

ReportProperties.Description: President Wiktor Smolak has refused our invitation to join talks for a South Merkopan alliance, following our inability to reach an agreement regarding the Zille handover.
ReportProperties.Title: Wehlen Backs Out Of Regional Alliance Talks

ReportProperties.Description: President Wiktor Smolak has refused our invitation to join talks for a South Merkopan alliance, citing unresolved differences with Rizia and his neighbors. He stresses that the handover of Zille will still go as planned.
ReportProperties.Title: Wehlen Backs Out Of Regional Alliance Talks

ReportProperties.Description: Amidst escalating tensions in the region, Wehlen's President, Wiktor Smolak, has issued a statement raising concerns about Rumburg's aggressive manoeuvres. Expressing unease over Rumburg's clandestine support for the Bludish Freedom Front, Smolak warns Sordland to stay vigilant. This warning comes on the heels of a recent aerial engagement between Sordland and Rumburg, further inflaming the already volatile atmosphere.
ReportProperties.Title: Wehlen Raises Concerns Over Rumburg Posturing

ReportProperties.Description: Tens of thousands turned out on the streets of Zille to celebrate its return to Rizia. Monarchist banners were flown, with Romus’ name being loudly shouted by the crowds in reverence.
ReportProperties.Title: Zille Celebrates Return

ReportProperties.Description: Preparations are currently underway for the upcoming reunification speech and signing ceremony led by the king.
ReportProperties.Title: Preparations Begin for King's Reunification Event

ReportProperties.Description:
Preliminary findings from the investigation into the assassination of Adarfo Sotelato suggest potential involvement of Arcasian private military contractors. Forensic analysis of materials recovered from the Golden Dusk attack points to the use of advanced weaponry and equipment commonly linked to Arcasian manufacturers. High-caliber rounds found at the scene match known specifications of Arcasian military exports.

This revelation has the potential to inflame tensions with Arcasia, as Rizian protesters accuse Arcasia of interference and demanding the Crown to take action.
ReportProperties.Title: Adarfo Sotelato's Murder Investigation Reveals Possible Arcasian Involvement

ReportProperties.Description: We have several reports that Agnolia is mobilizing troops toward their capital Staalport. A suspicious number of civilian ships have gathered at the city port, and some of our generals are growing wary that Agnolia might use the Rumburg war as cover to attempt to retake Heljiland from Valgsland with a naval invasion.
ReportProperties.Title: Inexplicable Manoeuvres from Agnolian Armies

ReportProperties.Description: The Republic of Agnolia officially put forward a bit to join ATO. It is likely that they will be entering the Arcasian sphere as President Walker has tentatively accepted their bid to gain more foothold against CSP.
ReportProperties.Title: Agnolia Puts Forward Bid to Join ATO

ReportProperties.Description: In the wake of the harrowing assassination attempt on President Rayne, Agnolia's Prime Minister, Maartin Van Hoorten, has sent his heartfelt condolences. The Prime Minister conveyed his deep concern and expressed solidarity with Sordland in these trying times. Van Hoorten called upon his citizens to remain vigilant, stressing the importance of maintaining peace and stability in the region.
ReportProperties.Title: Agnolia Expresses Solidarity Following Assassination Attempt

ReportProperties.Description: Agnolia’s commander has sent us military reports that all their armies are in place to launch a full-scale assault on Dome. The country has positioned its best troops at the front line and announced that they are committed to liberating their city from Rumburg's tyranny.
ReportProperties.Title: Agnolia Prepares Assault on Dome

ReportProperties.Description: Agnolia’s commander has sent us reports that their armies are in place to launch a full assault on Dome. Yet their numbers seem to betray their commitment to retake the city, as a significant portion of the country’s forces have stayed behind to defend Heljiland from a potential Valgslandian invasion.
ReportProperties.Title: Agnolia Prepares To Assault Dome

ReportProperties.Description:
Due to our pro-Soll policies, a large majority of USP conservative voters said that they would likely vote for president Rayne.

In addition, our Vice President, Gloria Tory, has been hosting rallies trying to consolidate their support.
ReportProperties.Title: Vice President Tory Consolidates Conservative Base

ReportProperties.Description: After days of travel from Holsord to Lachaven, the Lespian armies requested to rest and restock their supplies in Anrica. However, the mayor of Anrica has refused to let foreign armies enter a Sordish city due to fear of upheaval or even a potential takeover, further delaying the arrival of Lespia’s army to the frontline.
ReportProperties.Title: Lespian Armies Slowed Down

ReportProperties.Description: The newly deployed Wruhec’s Guardians have started an intensive anti-union campaign in Argno, rooting out any remaining pro union sentiment among workers. The guardians highlight the importance of work in the Wruhecist values, saying everyone should work together to achieve Golconda instead of squabbling over things like pay and working conditions.
ReportProperties.Title: Wruhec’s Guardians Prevent Union Activity

ReportProperties.Description: Agnolia's commander reported that his armies might not arrive in time for the battle, placing the blame on the poor infrastructure in the Agnland region slowing down the movement of their units.
ReportProperties.Title: Agnolia's Late Arrival

ReportProperties.Description:
Agnolia's commander reported that his armies are in position in the Agnland region to help with the upcoming battle. He applauded Sordish infrastructure as his armies traversed smoothly through the region's improved roadway network.

The H-3 highway will be a key logistical link for transporting troops and supplies to and from Agnolia.
ReportProperties.Title: Agnolian Army Ready in Agnland

ReportProperties.Description:
The ATO has granted observer status to Agard, a nation infamously known for its central role in the drug trade spanning Kalrad, Erdmarg, Wehlen, and Agard itself. While condemning the illegal activities, the ATO seeks a collaborative approach, with a focus on the socio-economic impact of the rampant drug trafficking. Agard's narco-lord, Severo Rios, has voiced intentions to legitimize the drug trade, aiming for regulation over exploitation.

With Rios at its helm, Agard's entry as an observer into the ATO signifies a potential diplomatic approach towards tackling the illicit drug trade. This move indicates Rios's commitment to engage transparently with the international community, which, despite skepticism, offers an opportunity for dialogue and resolution.
ReportProperties.Title: ATO Grants Agard Observer Status, Addressing Drug Trade

ReportProperties.Description:
Amid escalating tensions between United Contana and Arcasia, the Arcasian Treaty Organization has signed a non-aggression pact with the Federation of Anrakan Isles. Located strategically between the continents of Merkopa and Contana, the federation provides a critical diplomatic and security buffer. Its influential naval fleet supports stability in the region and ensures uninterrupted global commerce.

The geographical location and naval strength of the Anrakan Isles enable it to act as a neutral ground for global trade, maintaining open trade routes despite ongoing superpower confrontations. The agreement reflects efforts to ensure regional peace and highlights the federation's role as a key player in economic cooperation.
ReportProperties.Title: ATO Signs Non-Aggression Pact for 3 Years with Anraka

ReportProperties.Description:
In a major diplomatic development, the ATO has declared the World Liberation Manifestation (WLM), a strategic vision focused on promoting liberty, equity, and wealth across the globe. This declaration marks the ATO's dedication to advance these core values, serving as a counterpoint to the CSP's recent World Revolution Manifesto.

The WLM advocates for a world where freedom, fairness, and prosperity reign supreme. These principles are rooted in the ATO's belief in a free-market economy and democratic governance, and they reflect the alliance's commitment to enhancing the global quality of life. This manifesto seeks to influence global policies and negotiations, promoting a future where every individual can exercise their liberties, enjoy equal opportunities, and share in global wealth.

This vision contrasts the CSP's model, offering an alternative path to global prosperity. The ATO asserts that through the principles of the WLM, nations can achieve sustainable growth without sacrificing their individual freedoms. The WLM thus signifies a bold step towards a globalized world where prosperity is shared, liberties are upheld, and equity is non-negotiable.
ReportProperties.Title: ATO Declares World Liberation Manifestation

ReportProperties.Description:
Our Vice President, Lucian Galade, has been hosting massive rallies trying to sway both the conservative and reformist voters while also trying to attract new undecided voters.

Fortunately, the great and extraordinary oratory skills of the VP has led to many new voters to flock to the USP. The VP is shining while expanding the potential voter base.
ReportProperties.Title: Vice President Galade Shines during Campaign

ReportProperties.Description:
Our Vice President, Lucian Galade, has been hosting rallies trying to sway both the conservative and reformist voters while also trying to attract new undecided voters.

Unfortunately, due to their close relationship with the administration and the unpopular reputation, the VP is struggling to draw in voters.
ReportProperties.Title: Vice President Galade Struggles during Campaign

ReportProperties.Description: Recent polls suggest a surprising amount of support from women in Sordland. According to our pollsters, 53.4% of women said that they will vote for President Rayne due to the improvements in the women's rights situation.
ReportProperties.Title: Women For Rayne

ReportProperties.Description:
The admirals have been working tirelessly along with their CSP counterparts to modernise our navy. The regiments training have been changed to include more maneuvering exercises as well as naval invasion training.

Our destroyers have been retrofitted with the latest technology hull plating and cutting-edge main guns transported from United Contana. General Staff reports that the Sordish Navy has never been in a better condition.
ReportProperties.Title: CSP Modernises Sordland Navy

ReportProperties.Description: Sordish media mogul and businessman, Marcel Koronti, has officially endorsed us to be the next President of Sordland. With Mr. Koronti's wide-ranging connections and new media power, we can expect more votes in the upcoming election.
ReportProperties.Title: Marcel Koronti Endorsed President Rayne

ReportProperties.Description: With the election drawing near, our staff at the Maroon Palace has conducted general election polls all across Sordland. Our election polls show that around 38% of Sordish citizens would likely vote for the USP in the upcoming election.
ReportProperties.Title: Election Poll Results

ReportProperties.Description:
The Contanan Security Pact has issued a strong warning to the Guild of Royal Allies for Commercial Exchange, condemning its plans to establish an anti-Malenyevist military alliance. The CSP accused GRACE of actively undermining its ideological foundation and destabilizing the region, labeling the proposed military union a deliberate provocation. The statement described GRACE’s actions as a direct threat to peace and pledged decisive measures to counter what it sees as an escalation of hostility.

Rejecting the notion of dialogue, the CSP asserted that GRACE’s intentions align with external powers seeking to weaken the pact. The leadership emphasized its readiness to defend its principles and regional interests against this perceived threat, calling on its allies to prepare for a united response to the growing ideological and military challenge.
ReportProperties.Title: CSP Warns GRACE Against Formation of Anti-Malenyevist Union

ReportProperties.Description:
Vice-Secretary Chairman Toqezintli Iyotake of the United Assembly of United Contana has made a groundbreaking announcement. He has proposed the World Revolution Manifesto, a revolutionary vision calling for an ideological shift towards Malenyevism and Valgslandian Socialism globally. This manifesto aims to revolutionize global governance, focusing on investment in education, infrastructure, and health, rather than military investments.

The World Revolution Manifesto is seen as a continuation of CSP's colossal investment scheme initiated three years ago. This scheme had channeled 150 billion KS into Rika's infrastructure and education sectors, transforming the continents social landscape and shaping it as a beacon of sustainable development. This new manifesto, while global in scope, aims to replicate this success, fostering a worldwide revolution.

The approach is a peaceful one, favoring socio-economic development over military power. The goal is to construct a world where liberty, equality, and wealth are universally accessible.
ReportProperties.Title: World Revolution Manifesto: A Revolutionary Step

ReportProperties.Description: Derdia has condemned our policy of deploying Wruhec’s Guardians to maintain order across the country, saying the fundamentalist organization unfairly targets Golcondists.
ReportProperties.Title: Derdia Condemns Wruhec’s Guardians

ReportProperties.Description: Bergia’s Bludish community has been holding rallies protesting the presence of Wehzek troops in the region. Even though the protests have been peaceful so far, local police forces are staying vigilant in case the demonstrators turn violent.
ReportProperties.Title: Peaceful Protests in Bergia

ReportProperties.Description: The Bludish citizens of Deyr have barricaded the entrances to the city, forcing the Wehlen army to circle around it in order to move forward to Lachaven. The Wehzek generals reportedly debated mounting an attack on Deyr before deciding to press on.
ReportProperties.Title: Deyr Resists Wehlen Troops

ReportProperties.Description: The opinion polls on minority voter groups have been very positive, especially from the Bludish citizens in our country. Thanks to our relaxed immigration law, their votes will have a larger impact on the election.
ReportProperties.Title: Minority Poll Results

ReportProperties.Description: The opinion polls on minority voter groups have been very positive, especially from the Bludish citizens. However, due to our tighten immigration law, their votes will only have a small impact on the election outcome.
ReportProperties.Title: Minority Poll Results

ReportProperties.Description: Due to the continued upheaval in Bergia, the Archpriest of Deyr has made the decision that the Archsanctuary, the most holy site of the Nurist religion, will no longer be holding public services. The building is currently surrounded by protective barricades and remains as yet unharmed.
ReportProperties.Title: Archsanctuary Closes To The Public

ReportProperties.Description:
The airforce generals have been working tirelessly along with their ATO counterparts to modernise our airforce. The regiments training have been changed to include more maneuvering exercises as well as night time bombing training.

Our warplanes have been retrofitted with the latest technology radar systems and cutting-edge bombs transported from Arcasia. General Staff reports that the Sordish Airforce has never been in a better condition.
ReportProperties.Title: ATO Modernises Sordland Airforce

ReportProperties.Description: The Air Force has issued a warning against non-essential air travel. Civilians are discouraged from booking flights except in the case of business purposes or to visit sick or dying relatives.
ReportProperties.Title: Air Force Issues Civilian Flight Warning

ReportProperties.Description:
Our Vice President, Petr Vectern, has been hosting massive rallies trying to sway both the conservative and reformist voters while also trying to attract new undecided voters.

Fortunately, the great charisma of the VP has led to many new voters to flock to the USP, the VP is shining while expanding the potential voter base.
ReportProperties.Title: Vice President Vectern Shines during Campaign

ReportProperties.Description:
Our Vice President, Petr Vectern, has been hosting rallies trying to sway both the conservative and reformist voters while also trying to attract new undecided voters.

Unfortunately, due to their close relationship with the administration and the unpopular reputation, the VP is struggling to draw in voters.
ReportProperties.Title: Vice President Vectern Struggles during Campaign

ReportProperties.Description:
At 7.00, Rumburg launched their tactical bombers ready to bomb our trenches across the border.

Our fighters attempted to limit their bombers' effectiveness. Dogfights occurred in the sky as bombs dropped across the battlefield for several hours straight.

At 10.00, Rumburg initiated an all-out assault with their tank columns leading the attack. Our hulled-down tanks managed to barely hold the line, while our infantry fought in the trenches nearby supporting them.
ReportProperties.Title: Rumburg’s First Wave

ReportProperties.Description:
After 3 hours of constant fighting the momentum of the Rumburg armies started to die down.

As General Valken was about to order an all-out assault to puncture Rumburg's defensive line at Crimsrad, news of our eastern front's collapse in Agnland arrived. Rumburgs military pressure started to mount up again following the event. 

As we were unable to send troops to support the eastern flank, the only option was to retreat all divisions back to Lachaven to avoid a full encirclement by the enemy.
ReportProperties.Title: Rumburg’s First Wave - Conclusion

ReportProperties.Description:
After three hours of constant fighting, the momentum of the Rumburg armies started to die down.

General Kruger ordered an all-out assault to puncture their defensive line at Crimsrad. Before they could reorganize, Sordland's flag was already flying high in Crimsrad.

The news led to the collapse of Rumburg troop morale across the battle line. As we started gaining ground, Rumburg generals ordered a full retreat back to defend Tzarsbourgh to avoid a full collapse of the front, not realizing that our tanks and infantry were already assaulting Tzarsbourgh’s garrisons.
ReportProperties.Title: Rumburg’s First Wave - Conclusion

ReportProperties.Description:
Following the Sordish army’s successful invasion of Tzarsbourgh, our commanding officers held a meeting in the city itself to review the battle plans for the second phase of our military operation.

The meeting went well and the generals walked out of the room with an optimistic projection for the assault on Dome.
ReportProperties.Title: Optimistic Phase Two Meeting

ReportProperties.Description:
Following the Sordish army’s successful invasion of Tzarsbourgh, our commanding officers held a meeting in the city itself to review the battle plans for the second phase of our military operation.

However, the meeting quickly devolved into loud arguments between the generals, who walked out of the room with somber faces and pessimistic projections.
ReportProperties.Title: Loud Arguments In Phase Two Meeting

ReportProperties.Description:
Following the Sordish army’s successful invasion of Tzarsbourgh, our commanding officers held a meeting in the city itself to review the battle plans for the second phase of our military operation.

The meeting went well and the generals walked out of the room with an optimistic projection for the assault on Thornbourgh.
ReportProperties.Title: Phase Two Meeting

ReportProperties.Description: As part of the new order to secede Estord to Rumburg, population exchange of Sordish and Rumburgian citizens has begun. Police forces were assigned to the city to prevent potential violent escalations.
ReportProperties.Title: Population Exchange Begins

ReportProperties.Description:
At 7.00 in the morning, the Rumburg armies marched into the city of Estord. The city was empty, its citizens having been evacuated days earlier. 

At 9.00, while the Rumburg armies were savaging and looting what was left of Estord, General Lancea sounded the signal for an all-out assault. At 12.45, our first wave clashed with their southern flank.

At 15.13, our pincer attack started to take shape as the eastern and western armies began to enclose the enemy. The intensive fighting happened both in the sky and on the ground throughout the night.
ReportProperties.Title: Battle of Estord

ReportProperties.Description:
At 4.00 following the day, Rumburg troops defending the eastern front of Estord routed. In that crucial moment, Rumburg's commander made a decision that changed the tide of the battle.He ordered all divisions to withdraw to the central area of the city.

At 11.00, as our troops pushed in the vicinity from all sides, the Rumburg general ordered all his men to do a full assault to the east to break out. We were caught off guard and by the time the other armies got to the eastern front, the fighting turned into a melee. 

They managed to break our eastern front and stopped our pincer. With their rear free of our soldiers, they turned around and commenced a full assault on our remaining armies.
ReportProperties.Title: Battle of Estord - Conclusion

ReportProperties.Description:
At 4.00 following the day, Rumburg troops defending the eastern front of Estord routed.

Our general commanding the army on the eastern side immediately signaled the victorious news to our headquarters and in the meantime telegraphed the news internationally and to all propaganda spies in Rumburg.

With their shattered eastern front, their flank was exposed and their supply lines were cut off. As we slowly gained ground, the Rumburg general capitulated.

At 14.00 on the same day, Sordland's flag was raised on top of Estord once again.
ReportProperties.Title: Battle of Estord - Conclusion

ReportProperties.Description:
At 7.00, we initiated an all-out bombing and artillery barrage across Rumburg’s line in Crimsrad and the logistic points between Crimsrad and Tzarsbourgh.

At 7.30, our planes were spotted in Estord. Rumburg launched their fighters as a countermeasure to our air assault. 

At 9.30, General Lancea ordered the first army to push through the enemy line into Crimsrad. Our tank divisions in the first army charged forward, facing the Rumburg tanks head-on with our infantry behind to support them.
ReportProperties.Title: March Toward Tzarsbourgh

ReportProperties.Description:
As our armies were about to reach a breakthrough of Rumburg's defensive line at Crimsrad, news of our eastern front's collapse in Agnland arrived. Rumburg military pressure started to mount up. 

Because we couldn't support the eastern flank, the only option at the time was to retreat all divisions back to Lachaven to avoid a full encirclement by the enemy. 

Unfortunately, as we retreated, we suffered a very high amount of casualties.
ReportProperties.Title: March Toward Tzarsbourgh - Conclusion

ReportProperties.Description:
With our tanks leading the charge, we managed to push through Rumburg’s defenses. Before Rumburg could respond to our offensive, Sordland's flag was flying high in Crimsrad.

The news of the fall of the city led to the collapse of Rumburg troop's morale across the battleline. As we started gaining ground, Rumburg generals ordered a full retreat back to defend Tzarsbourgh to avoid a full collapse of the front, not realizing that our tanks and infantry were already assaulting Tzarsbourgh’s garrisons.
ReportProperties.Title: March Toward Tzarsbourgh - Conclusion

ReportProperties.Description:
Rumburg bombing runs began yesterday night. They have leveled most of the urban areas attacking hospitals and schools alike. There are many dead among the civilian populace. Local commanders report civilians and wounded children are inside their target areas.

We are sending more anti-air systems to Estord to defend the city but the local defences are heavily damaged.
ReportProperties.Title: Hospitals and Schools Bombed in Estord

ReportProperties.Description:
A bill to ban death penalty was proposed by the RPP today in the House of Delegates, and passed into law by majority vote. 

The new law replaces capital punishment with life imprisonment, offering a second chance for reform and ensuring justice aligns with the principles of human dignity. Prisoners currently on death row will now serve life sentences under the updated legal framework.
ReportProperties.Title: House of Delegates Bans Death Penalty

ReportProperties.Description: We have received the schedule for the upcoming Alliance of Nations session. According to the dates outlined, Sordland One is being prepared for the flight to Konstantium, Kyrute. Minister of Foreign Affairs Deivid Wisci will be attending the session as well as accompanying Mr. President on the flight.
ReportProperties.Title: Schedule for the Alliance of Nations Session

ReportProperties.Description: The AN Ambassador has strongly condemned us after the recent rhetorical escalation against the Alliance of Nations. Sordland has received a warning that the international community will not stand by while our nation is adding fuel to the fire.
ReportProperties.Title: AN Ambassador Condemns Sordland

ReportProperties.Description: The AN Ambassador has extended their full support after the recent revelations about Rumburg on the international stage. Sordland has received a guarantee that the international community will stand by its territorial integrity and independence in these times. This boost the confidence of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
ReportProperties.Title: AN Ambassador Supports Sordland

ReportProperties.Description: In light of the encroaching war with Rumburg, the USP Congress will not happen this year. President Anton Rayne retains his position as party leader, and will represent United Sordland as a presidential candidate in the coming elections.
ReportProperties.Title: USP Congress Cancelled

ReportProperties.Description: With the new powers that it has been granted, the Sordish military has assumed responsibility for keeping peace within Sordland’s borders, overriding local police authority. Extra troops have been dispatched to Camp Strongarm to manage the growing unrest in Holsord.
ReportProperties.Title: Military Assumes Interior Security Duties

ReportProperties.Description: With the emergency still being active during the elections, our police will be monitoring the voting procedures very closely to ensure the right votes are cast. The security forces will ensure that only the rightly 'eligible' and 'legal' votes can be cast at the ballot.
ReportProperties.Title: Emergency Extended Votes

ReportProperties.Description: A nationwide mobilization order has been issued to reinforce our manpower pool. New recruits will be mostly serving as reserves but we will prepare for the worst case scenario. Approximately one million men have been recruited so far and they will begin their accelerated training immediately.
ReportProperties.Title: Nationwide Mobilization Order

ReportProperties.Description: The Bank of Kyrute is happy to inform you that the transfer of your personal assets has completed successfully. It will take approximately 30 business days for the amount to be withdrawable in local territory. Thank you for choosing BoK.
ReportProperties.Title: Money Transfer Completed

ReportProperties.Description:
AN intelligence has confirmed that the information from the Rumburgian whistleblower was true. Rumburg does have nuclear weapons capable of threatening Sordland and Eastern Merkopa.

The Alliance of Nations ratified a barrage of sanctions on Rumburg by the member states.
ReportProperties.Title: Existence of Nuclear Weapons in Rumburg Confirmed

ReportProperties.Description:
Jubilant Sordish citizens in Holsord saw off hundreds of thousands Lespian soldiers and armored vehicles as they departed on the L-1-Railway to the Estord frontline.

Recordings and news of the massive, technologically advanced force have emboldened the morale of our soldiers as well as the war support of our citizens.
ReportProperties.Title: Morale Surges As Lespian Armies Depart Holsord

ReportProperties.Description: With the now ex-Interior Minister Lileas Graf challenging President Anton Rayne following her resignation, a congress has been called at which members of the USP will determine the party’s future leadership. At the Grand National Assembly, both Graf and Rayne will make speeches, after which the votes will be cast.
ReportProperties.Title: USP Congress Called

ReportProperties.Description: Following the deadly rioting that targeted religious minorities in Rizia, a local RPP branch in Iza has attempted to mend the rift, bringing together securalists, Wruhecists and various minorities to redirect their anger towards the central government instead of towards each other.
ReportProperties.Title: RPP Reaches Out To Religious Groups

ReportProperties.Description: The diverse city of Iza has seen overnight scenes of celebration, with many in the traditional RPP stronghold celebrating the inauguration of Manus Sazon as the first Prime Minister of the country. For the first time in a long time, many ethnic and religious minorities feel like their voice is represented in government.
ReportProperties.Title: Iza Erupts In Celebration As Manus Named PM

ReportProperties.Description: In Iza, thousands flooded the main square, chanting against the king's plans for the House of Delegates. The protest became difficult to manage, but law enforcement eventually dispersed the crowd after prolonged efforts.
ReportProperties.Title: Iza Demonstrations Quelled After Intense Stand-Off

ReportProperties.Description: In Iza, a brief protest broke out in the main square, chanting against the king's plans for the House of Delegates. Law enforcement responded swiftly, dispersing the crowd with minimal resistance.
ReportProperties.Title: Protests in Iza Dissolved Within an Hour

ReportProperties.Description: Riots broke out in Iza following the announcement that Manus Sazon was executed. Supporters of the Rizian People's Party, who long held the hope that the Sazon would bring about change, attacked police stations and other symbols of Royal power.
ReportProperties.Title: Rioting As Iza Commemorates Manus Sazon

ReportProperties.Description:
Scores of Golcondist- and Dastnurist-owned businesses, often run by immigrants from Derdia and Wehlen, have been destroyed by religious demonstrators, blaming the country's woes on heretic influences from abroad. At least eight people have been reportedly killed as certain shop owners resisted, but they were no match for the religious fervor.

Reportedly, Su Omina members eagerly joined in on the rioting. Eventually, law enforcement restored order, announcing swift trials for those arrested.
ReportProperties.Title: Golcondist And Dastnurist Businesses Destroyed

ReportProperties.Description:
Scores of Golcondist and Dastnurist-owned businesses, often run by immigrants from Derdia and Wehlen, have been destroyed by religious demonstrators, blaming the country's woes on heretic influences from abroad. At least twenty people have been reportedly killed as certain shop owners resisted, but they were no match for the religious fervor. 

The Wruhec’s Guardians stationed in the city helped coordinate the attacks, providing lists of foreign-owned businesses to the demonstrators and ensuring law enforcement stayed away from the violence. Reportedly, Su Omina members eagerly joined in on the rioting.
ReportProperties.Title: Golcondist And Dastnurist Businesses Destroyed

ReportProperties.Description: Profiting from the housing subsidies granted by the Crown to poor families, landowners in Iza have started rapidly increasing rents, draining the royal coffers in the process. Due to the acute housing crisis gripping Iza, tenants often have no choice but to accept these rent increases.
ReportProperties.Title: Iza Landlords Up Rents

ReportProperties.Description: Hundreds of Su Omina members marched through Iza at night time, torches lit in honor of Rico Toras, who many once considered to be one of them. About one hour in, security forces loyal to the Crown broke up the parade, on the grounds that all commemorations for traitors to the Kingdom is forbidden.
ReportProperties.Title: Su Omina Torch Parade In Honor Of Rico

ReportProperties.Description: What was supposed to be a peaceful demonstration in downtown Jen turned violent as a number of participants brought weapons, leading to bloody clashes between protesters and counter-protestors. Several bystanders were caught in the crossfire; the number of wounded is not yet known.
ReportProperties.Title: Peaceful Protest Turns Violent

ReportProperties.Description: The Republic of Kyrute and its banking sector warmly welcome President Anton Rayne's decision to transfer personal finances to our trusted institutions. This act further solidifies the financial relationship between Kyrute and Sordland, and the Chancellor extends assurance of utmost security and confidentiality regarding these assets.
ReportProperties.Title: Presidents Finances Welcomed in Kyrute

ReportProperties.Description: The Republic of Kyrute has welcomed the peace treaty in Pales, calling for a swift resumption of regular civilian life. The country highlights the need for reconciliation between Palesians and Rizians after all the destruction that’s been caused.
ReportProperties.Title: Kyrute Welcomes Peace

ReportProperties.Description: Under the orders of the military, naval corps are being transferred from the Conriat Naval Base to the Port of Lachaven in order to better oversee the flow of imports and exports into and out of Sordland.
ReportProperties.Title: Navy Oversees Import and Export Flow

ReportProperties.Description: The debate between the candidates in the next Sordish presidential election is slated to take place tomorrow evening at the Sordish Broadcasting Corporation headquarters in Lachaven. It will be broadcast live on television, and several million households are expected to tune in.
ReportProperties.Title: Presidential Debate Prep in Lachaven

ReportProperties.Description:
Due to our reformist policies, a large majority of USP reformist voters said that they would likely vote for president Rayne.

In addition, our Vice President, Albin Clavin, has been hosting rallies trying to consolidate their support. Unfortunately, they are only the minority in USP so we may have to look for more votes elsewhere.
ReportProperties.Title: Vice President Clavin Consolidates Reformist Base

ReportProperties.Description: Sordish businessman, Walter Tusk, has officially endorsed us to be the next President of Sordland in the upcoming 57' election. With Mr.Tusk's wide-ranging connections and power, we can expect more business owners and pro-economy citizens to vote for us.
ReportProperties.Title: Walter Tusk Endorsed President Rayne

ReportProperties.Description: Our generals in the front line are requesting more ammunition, grenades, and medical equipment on the front line. According to their reports, our troops are barely holding the line and some of our soldiers can't even shoot back due to the lack of ammunition. Our Artillery units have to fire selectively which caused a big rift between our generals on where should our focus be. Unfortunately, we are straining our resources and won't have enough to support the entire front line.
ReportProperties.Title: Our Frontlines Request More Supply

ReportProperties.Description:
A flurry of activity in the skies above Lachaven is invigorating the region's military readiness. Our strategic allies from Lespia have dispatched their renowned air wings to our military airfields, executing daily drills as they prepare for the prospect of conflict. The state-of-the-art aircraft flown by these experienced pilots paint a formidable image of air supremacy. 

The spectacle is not merely a testament to our military preparedness; it has also become a profound morale booster for our ground troops. The presence of these skilled Lespian aviators signals strong ally support and deepens the resolve of our military personnel.
ReportProperties.Title: Lespian Airforce Soar in Sordish Sky

ReportProperties.Description: Our Generals sent us their deepest gratitude for our excellent administrative work on the home front. Our artillery units are continuously shelling the enemy without concern over ammunition. Thanks to the continuous supply of medical equipment, we have minimized the number of casualties. They were able to initiate continuous assaults due to the successes of the home front.
ReportProperties.Title: Our Generals Express Their Gratitude

ReportProperties.Description: As violent protests continue throughout Sordland, authorities in Lachaven are reporting out-of-control looting at the shops along Republic Avenue, with multiple windows broken and high-value items stolen.
ReportProperties.Title: Republic Avenue Looted

ReportProperties.Description:
The mayor of Lachaven has reported that Valgslandian transport ships have docked at the port and their troops are moving to the frontline. However, certain citizens have displayed animosity towards the Valgslandian soldiers.

Fortunately, no violence has occurred during the deployment of the troops.
ReportProperties.Title: Valgsland Armies Arrived in Lachaven

ReportProperties.Description:
In the places Rumburg soldiers managed to break our defense, there have been atrocious reports of war crimes. These reports outline death marches on the dislocated civilian populations and mistreatment of prisoners.

According to a field commander they do not fight like a regular army. Reports of new chemical weapons have been sent over to Holsord. The war crimes will be reported to the international community for the whole world to see.
ReportProperties.Title: Rumburg War Crimes

ReportProperties.Description: The Republic of Lespia reaffirms its steadfast dedication to the alliance with Sordland. The Lespian Armed Forces remain prepared to stand in solidarity with our allies in any challenge that may arise. Should Sordland seek Lespia's support, our nation will respond without hesitation.
ReportProperties.Title: Lespia’s Army Stands Ready

ReportProperties.Description: Lespia has formally sent their condolences to the family of Rusty Montoro, claiming the death of a talented businessman like him is ‘rather tragic’ and a ‘great loss to global capital’.
ReportProperties.Title: Lespia Laments Loss Of Great Businessman

ReportProperties.Description: The Republic of Lespia hereby reiterates commitment to peace in Eastern Merkopa. The tensions between Rumburg and Sordland have to be prevented to escalate further. We are strongly urging calm in the region.
ReportProperties.Title: Lespia Urges Calm

ReportProperties.Description: The Lespian military command joined with the Sordish military command. Latest reports are indicating that their armored and mechanized divisions are on their way to support the 1st Army.
ReportProperties.Title: Lespian Army on its Way

ReportProperties.Description: In Monqiz, a large-scale protest erupted, with demonstrators occupying key intersections to oppose the king’s plans for the House of Delegates. The gathering proved difficult to quell, but authorities managed to disperse the crowd after several tense hours.
ReportProperties.Title: Monqiz Demonstrators Dispersed After Prolonged Protest

ReportProperties.Description: Protests in Monqiz erupted in opposition to the king’s plans for the House of Delegates, but the gathering was quickly contained and disbanded by local law enforcement.
ReportProperties.Title: Quick Resolution to Monqiz Protests Following King's Decision

ReportProperties.Description: An eerie quiet has fallen over Monqiz’ Toras palace, with many saddened by the execution of Hugo Toras, who almost everyone in the Palace had some sort of personal connection to. Footsteps are the only remaining sound that echoes through the great hallways.
ReportProperties.Title: Halls Of Monqiz Palace Quiet

ReportProperties.Description: The Azaro’s have held a small military parade in Montaklar, officially to honor ‘all dead family members’. While the parade didn’t mention recent executions to avoid Royal repression, the matter was on everyone's minds.
ReportProperties.Title: Azaros Hold Vigil For Fallen Family Members

ReportProperties.Description:
The province of Cardesse-Montaklar, long recognized for its military strength and industrial significance, has been formally placed under the direct authority of the Crown. With this shift, House Azaro has relinquished its royal estates and titles.

As part of the transition, portraits of King Romus and the Royal Family have replaced those of the Azaro leadership in Montaklar City Hall, symbolizing the new governance. Additionally, Camp Domus, Rizia's primary military base, has been renamed Camp Romus, reflecting the province’s new allegiance.
ReportProperties.Title: Montaklar Transitions to Direct Crown Rule

ReportProperties.Description:
To prevent religious-inspired rioting causing large scale property damage and deaths, Wruhec’s Guardians stationed in Montaklar have preventively closed all shops owned by non Wruhecists in the city indefinitely. 

Despite initial protest by Montaklar’s significant Golcondist community against the measure, many shop owners have started leaving the city, facing no other choice than to look for employment elsewhere.
ReportProperties.Title: Wruhec’s Guardians Preventively Close Minority Shops

ReportProperties.Description: Montaklar saw a massive turnout as citizens marched through the streets in defiance of the king’s decision regarding the House of Delegates. Despite facing resistance, authorities eventually restored order.
ReportProperties.Title: Massive Montaklar Protest Dispersed After Hours of Resistance

ReportProperties.Description: In Montaklar, protesters gathered in response to the king's recent decision regarding the House of Delegates, though the demonstration was brief, with authorities dispersing the group swiftly and without incident.
ReportProperties.Title: Montaklar Protests Short-Lived as Authorities Intervene

ReportProperties.Description:
In the wake of the riots in Montaklar, House Azaro has swiftly reinforced security by deploying additional forces to key locations. 

General Carlos Robles Azaro has assured citizens that stability will be maintained, with curfews and military patrols to prevent further unrest. 
Local authorities report that government functions continue uninterrupted and that daily life remains unaffected. 

Businesses have been advised to follow security measures as tensions ease.
ReportProperties.Title: House Azaro Restores Order

ReportProperties.Description: The Azaro’s have hailed the acquisition of Pales into their territory, as the Royal House becomes the first one to control two distinct provinces. The family expressly thanked King Romus, as Azaro forces were dispatched to install order in the newly acquired region.
ReportProperties.Title: Azaro’s Celebrate Acquiring Pales

ReportProperties.Description: Morella has welcomed the signed peace treaty and is now calling for a quick return home for those who fled the conflict. The country is hosting many thousands of refugees and while it has accepted them graciously, it is also keen on them returning home now that the conflict is over.
ReportProperties.Title: Morella Calls For Quick Return Of Those Displaced

ReportProperties.Description: With the election drawing near, our staff at the Maroon Palace has conducted general election polls all across Sordland. Our election polls show that roughly 27% of Sordish citizens would prefer to vote for the USP in the upcoming election.
ReportProperties.Title: Election Poll Results

ReportProperties.Description: The Wehzek minority in Nanta, one of the largest in the Zille region, has organized a protest against the city’s return to Rizia. Local Wehzek leaders claimed the social standing of Wehzeks has significantly reduced since we assumed control.
ReportProperties.Title: Wehzeks Protest Return To Rizia

ReportProperties.Description: Sordish citizens in Narbel started protesting the forced relocation following the order. Rumburgian flags were burned and during the increasingly violent protests, arson attacks occurred all over the city. Firefighters are attending the scenes.
ReportProperties.Title: Arson Attacks in Narbel

ReportProperties.Description:
We stopped the continuous shelling of Narbel by Rumburgian artillery. Yesterday night, our artillery brigades have targeted their locations and destroyed their heavy weaponry in a counter-artillery strike.

Our division will take this opportunity and attempt a breakthrough to create a pocket to trap the enemy tanks. Vectern Sis Da!
ReportProperties.Title: Rumburg Artillery Targets Destroyed

ReportProperties.Description:
Reports are coming in that Wehzek soldiers have committed atrocities on their march through Narbel, specifically in the encampments where large numbers of Bludish and Rumburgian refugees from Lards and Datefort are housed.

Assault, looting and other violent acts are among the rumored war crimes.
ReportProperties.Title: Wehlen set Lards and Dateford in flames

ReportProperties.Description: The wall began as a network of barbed wire and makeshift barriers but is now being reinforced with concrete and watchtowers. Movement is heavily restricted, with crowds gathering on both sides, many attempting to flee before the final sections are completed.
ReportProperties.Title: The King's Wall

ReportProperties.Description: Our army’s military engineer corps is overseeing the cleanup of Pales, ensuring that any traces of the nerve gas we unleashed on the city are dealt with and to safeguard the civilian population against possible unintended further exposure.
ReportProperties.Title: Military Engineers Leading Chemical Cleanup

ReportProperties.Description:
Princess Vina appeared on the balcony of Castle Reinhart, together with her husband Axel, to thunderous applause from the hundreds of thousands that gathered in the Palesian capital to celebrate their countries unification with Rizia. 

In the coming days, Vina and Axel will visit more Palesian cities together, showcasing the newly found unity between Rizia and Pales.
ReportProperties.Title: Vina Greeted To Massive Crowds Amidst Unification Celebration

ReportProperties.Description: Any attempts of meaningful protest to our victory parade has been handled by military police units stationed in the former Palesian capital. While Palesian opposition to our victory has largely been broken, small sectors of society still show willingness to resist our rule, necessitating preventive arrest to prevent a threat to public security.
ReportProperties.Title: Army Maintains Order At Parade

ReportProperties.Description: Thousands have gathered in Bronaz, at the Blua Monte, the largest military cemetery in the country, to commemorate those fallen in the Pales war. The mood was very gloomy, with almost every family in the country knowing someone who was either injured or killed in the conflict. At the cemetery, over 23,000 soldiers are buried in sober, white coloured graves.
ReportProperties.Title: Vigil For The Fallen

ReportProperties.Description: A small prayer held at the Plavo sanctuary to commemorate Wiscerer Sal Ignacius, who was executed for being a traitor to the Crown, has been dispersed by our security forces. Currently, gatherings commemorating executed traitors are considered illegal, as they risk undermining the authority of the King’s decision.
ReportProperties.Title: Police Disperse Prayer For Sal

ReportProperties.Description: Pro democracy campaigners from across the political spectrum gathered in Porte Drazon, celebrating the signing of the new constitution, with a large rally held outside the House of Delegates. Speakers of both the RPP and RNC were present at the rally, a rare show of unity in support of a constitutional Rizia.
ReportProperties.Title: Thousands Celebrate New Constitution

ReportProperties.Description: Nearly three and a half million people marched in Porte Drazon against our reign, making it the largest demonstration in Rizian history. A jubilant mood was reported as the announcement of our abdication reached the protestors.
ReportProperties.Title: Largest Demonstration In Rizian History

ReportProperties.Description: In Porte Drazon, a large crowd gathered outside the palace gates to protest the king’s decision regarding the future of the House of Delegates after its closure. Authorities struggled to contain the demonstration, but after several hours, the protest was finally disbanded.
ReportProperties.Title: Porte Drazon Protests Disbanded After Hours of Tension

ReportProperties.Description: In Porte Drazon, a small but vocal protest formed near the king’s residence following his decision regarding the future of the House of Delegates after its closure.
ReportProperties.Title: Minor Protest Quickly Quelled in Porte Drazon

ReportProperties.Description:
Disgraced Duchess and former Queen Consort Lucita Azaro was rushed to the hospital from Porte Drazon Citadel late last night after experiencing heavy bleeding. Once there, it was determined that the three-month-old fetus she was carrying had been lost, most likely stemming from the stress of imprisonment.

Azaro herself is in stable condition.
ReportProperties.Title: Lucita Azaro Suffers Miscarriage In Prison

ReportProperties.Description:
The religious march on Porte Drazon is finally complete, with nearly half a million worshippers flooding the squares and boulevards of the city, where they now intend to stay indefinitely. 

Riots have broken out as the religious demonstrators attacked other protestors, unsuccessfully attempting to disperse republican and socialist oriented enemies of the state. Several casualties have been reported.
ReportProperties.Title: Half A Million Wruhecists Descend On Capital

ReportProperties.Description:
The religious march on Porte Drazon is finally complete, with nearly half a million worshippers flooding the squares and boulevards of the city, where they now intend to stay indefinitely. 

Riots have broken out as the religious demonstrators attacked other protestors, with the Wruhec’s Guardians helping them in dispersing republican and socialist oriented enemies of the state. Several casualties have been reported.
ReportProperties.Title: Half A Million Wruhecists Descend On Capital

ReportProperties.Description: The religious march on Porte Drazon is finally complete, with nearly a quarter of a million worshippers flooding the squares and boulevards of the city. As they made their point, the demonstrators have now begun their journey home, leaving the city behind as a tranquil oasis of peace.
ReportProperties.Title: Half A Million Wruhecists Descend On Capital

ReportProperties.Description: Due to inaction by the Government, wine production is taking more and more of a hit as the environmental crisis gripping Valenqiris worsens. Grapevines are unable to extract enough healthy nutrients from the poisoned soil, as increasing amounts of plants continue to die off.
ReportProperties.Title: Wine Production Falls As Environmental Crisis Worsens

ReportProperties.Description: Thanks to diligent efforts by the administration, viticultural experts have restored the previously downgraded grape ranking to its original rank. The measures taken by the government seem to be paying off, as groundwater pollutants are down and nature is starting to recover.
ReportProperties.Title: Grape Quality Ranking Recovers

ReportProperties.Description: Our army’s military engineer corps is overseeing the cleanup of Remaz, ensuring that any traces of the nerve gas we unleashed on the city are dealt with and to safeguard the civilian population against possible unintended further exposure.
ReportProperties.Title: Military Engineers Leading Chemical Cleanup

ReportProperties.Description: A large unity column is being built on Remaz’ grand market square, to celebrate the unification of Pales and Rizia. The column bears the insignia of all Rizian royal houses, including that of the Reinharts, with a golden Toras bull adorning the top.
ReportProperties.Title: Unity Column Erected On Grand Market Square

ReportProperties.Description: Vina and Axel have finished their grand unity tour of Pales in Remaz, the province’s second largest city. The couple unveiled the newly constructed victory column to enthusiastic cheers from the crowds.
ReportProperties.Title: Vina And Axel Finish Tour In Front Of Unity Column

ReportProperties.Description:
Efforts to rebuild Remaz, Pales’ second largest city, after the brutal siege are underway. At the center of the reconstruction process is a new Toras Column, complete with golden bull at the top, being built on the grand market square. 

Slowly, civilians displaced because of the war have started returning to the city.
ReportProperties.Title: Rebuilding Efforts Underway

ReportProperties.Description: The GRACE organization has extended its congratulations for the imminent ascension of Pales to our Kingdom, pointing to the increasing strength of a regional monarchy as a positive development.
ReportProperties.Title: GRACE Congratulates Us On Reunification

ReportProperties.Description: Our fellow members in the Intermerkopum Alliance have sent an official statement congratulating us on our victory against Pales, calling it a “turning point for regional power in South Merkopa.” They added that Intermerkopum remains committed to standing by Rizia, whatever threats we may face.
ReportProperties.Title: Intermerkopum Members Congratulate Us On Pales Victory

ReportProperties.Description: Rizia has declared Zille’s resource-rich lands a national development project. Industrial teams are assessing resource extraction sites while local environmental groups protest potential ecological damage.
ReportProperties.Title: Zille Developement Project

ReportProperties.Description: Rizia's application for membership in the ATO has been received, putting us on the road to candidate status. This move is seen as a step toward bolstering national security and reinforcing strategic alliances on the international stage.
ReportProperties.Title: Path to ATO Integration

ReportProperties.Description: Rizia's application for membership in the CSP was rejected, citing concerns over political alignment and economic compatibility. Despite this setback, officials emphasize that diplomatic efforts will continue to strengthen regional ties through alternative partnerships.
ReportProperties.Title: CSP Membership Denied, Diplomacy Continues

ReportProperties.Description: Rizia announced the formation of a modern navy, featuring aircraft carriers and jet-powered naval aviation. Expansion of Monqiz Port and Naval Shipyard has boosted the local economy, though the program remains in its early stages.
ReportProperties.Title: Rizian Armada

ReportProperties.Description: The issuance of "Sovereign Bonds" with no repayment plan has triggered severe public discontent. Citizens are frustrated by the financial strain imposed on them, leading to protests and demands for transparency. The initiative has failed to gain support and is being met with increasing resistance.
ReportProperties.Title: Sovereign Bonds Backlash

ReportProperties.Description: Rizia's launch of the Crown Restoration Pact to provide diplomatic and financial backing to pro-monarchy movements in unstable republics has earned strong support from GRACE members and Rizian loyalists.
ReportProperties.Title: Crown Restoration Pact

ReportProperties.Description: By refusing to recognize Zille’s new currency and flooding its markets with Rizian guilders, Rizia has destabilized the local economy. Smolak’s government is in turmoil, while rural areas increasingly rely on barter systems.
ReportProperties.Title: Zille Currency Crisis

ReportProperties.Description: A neutral border zone was established for trade and diplomacy between Rizia and Pales. While tensions remain high, the initiative is largely seen as a success by both populations.
ReportProperties.Title: Demilitarized Zone

ReportProperties.Description: The preliminary survey to assess the nation’s resources uncovered thorium deposits west of Iza. This discovery has sparked interest in nuclear energy, with the potential to significantly enhance Rizia’s energy independence and future economic growth.
ReportProperties.Title: Mass Excavation Project

ReportProperties.Description: Massive speakers along the Rizian-Zille border now blast patriotic Rizian music at high volumes. Local leaders condemn the act, while reports surfaced of wildlife disruption and hearing damage among border guards.
ReportProperties.Title: Wall of Sound

ReportProperties.Description: Rizia has officially renamed the Gulf of Moridia to the "Gulf of Rizia" to reflect its dominance in the region. The decision has sparked outrage from Derdia, Morella, and Wehlen, who refuse to recognize the change.
ReportProperties.Title: Gulf of Rizia Renaming

ReportProperties.Description: The decision to accept an alliance with the newly independent Zille has sparked mixed reactions. Critics warn of security risks and economic strain, while supporters highlight strengthened regional ties. A newly agreed-upon open border is expected to boost trade and mobility.
ReportProperties.Title: Alliance with Zille Draws Mixed Reactions

ReportProperties.Description: Construction of the King’s Wall has begun, symbolizing strength and unity under the Crown. The grand fortification is designed to solidify border defenses, deter external threats, and reinforce Rizia’s sovereignty.
ReportProperties.Title: The King's Wall

ReportProperties.Description: Rizia's introduction of mandatory stock investments has sparked public outrage, leading to widespread protests. Despite the financial losses, some investors continue to buy shares, trusting the long-standing stability of the monarchy and its economic influence.
ReportProperties.Title: Public Backlash Over Mandatory Stock Investments

ReportProperties.Description: Rizia’s investment into transforming its military capabilities continues with the expansion of strategic bases and the finalization of contracts for advanced weaponry. There have been limited protests regarding the potential economic strain and rising tensions, while supporters see the expansion as essential for national security.
ReportProperties.Title: National Militarization Initiative

ReportProperties.Description: Rizia's campaign to support Zillian refugees and resistance members has led thousands of families to cross the border, with temporary camps now established in Sallebus and Mave Nortus.
ReportProperties.Title: Operation Sanctuary

ReportProperties.Description: Our decision to grant Palesian citizens the ability to apply for Rizian passports has been met with praise by Duke Reinhart. The Palesian monarch emphasizes that although reunification between our nations is not an option, he wishes to maintain close ties and foster a spirit of mutual respect. The Rizian Ministry of Internal Affairs has outlined a phased implementation plan for the passport program, initially focusing on applicants with existing family connections, professional exchanges, or proven Rizian descent, eventually extended to anyone with Palesian citizenship.
ReportProperties.Title: Reinhart Praises Dual Citizenship Decision

ReportProperties.Description: Our decision to construct a high-speed railway between the Rizian and Palesian capitals has been warmly welcomed by the Pales provincial council. Key figures have emphasized the railway’s potential to boost trade, tourism, and labor mobility, while reducing travel time between the two capitals to under four hours. Construction is set to begin in the fourth quarter of this year,
ReportProperties.Title: Pales Officials Welcome New Railway Announcement

ReportProperties.Description: Military mobilization has begun as Rizia prepares to expand its control over all of Greater Pales, including territories currently held by Morella.
ReportProperties.Title: Preparations for Greater Pales Conquest

ReportProperties.Description: Elite-owned estates are being redistributed to common citizens, sparking condemnation from the upper class but celebration among lower-class Rizians who gain land ownership. As some wealthy families flee the kingdom, newly empowered citizens invest in local businesses, driving regional economic growth.
ReportProperties.Title: The People's Land Act

ReportProperties.Description: The Royal Patronage program has ignited a cultural renaissance, beginning with the revitalization of Old Town’s public spaces. This marks the first of many efforts to invest in art and architecture, preserving Rizia’s heritage while shaping its future.
ReportProperties.Title: Royal Patronage Initiative

ReportProperties.Description: The monarchy has directed royal patronage toward advancing cancer research, with substantial funding allocated to research institutions. This kingdom-wide focus aims to foster groundbreaking treatments and establish Rizia as a leader in the fight against cancer, benefiting both the nation and the world.
ReportProperties.Title: Royal Patronage Initiative

ReportProperties.Description: A portion of the Royal Charity Fund has been allocated to civil projects, including infrastructure improvements in rural areas and the expansion of public healthcare facilities. Public expectations for further large-scale projects remain high.
ReportProperties.Title: Royal Charity Fund

ReportProperties.Description: A new national holiday, Pales Reclamation Day, has been declared to honor Rizian resilience and reaffirm their claim to lost lands. While widely celebrated, the declaration sparks debate over future territorial ambitions.
ReportProperties.Title: Pales Reclamation Day

ReportProperties.Description: Pales City Hall has already begun preparations for next year's inaugural {RiziaDLCText.NewPalesHoliday}, a holiday established to emphasize the historical bond and present-day unity between the Palesian and Rizian people. The celebrations are expected to include a military parade and fireworks over the Pales harbor.
ReportProperties.Title: Preparations Begin for New Holiday

ReportProperties.Description: Monte Alzorria, a towering mountain near Porte Drazon, has been selected for the monumental carving of Rizia's greatest monarchs. Preparations are underway, with the renowned sculptor Julian Arizkun, who is based out of the University of Iza, leading the project.
ReportProperties.Title: Monumental Carving on Monte Alzorria

ReportProperties.Description: Thousands of balloons filled with Rizian garbage and manure were sent into Pales as a symbolic "tribute." Protests have erupted across Pales, with citizens expressing their outrage at the blatant insult and unsanitary conditions caused by the debris.
ReportProperties.Title: Royal Waste Initiative

ReportProperties.Description: As a result of the Royal Waste Initiative, strong winds have redirected many balloons back into Rizian territory, littering towns as far as Topes. Outraged locals have condemned the fiasco, demanding accountability for the mess and the foul stench now plaguing their communities.
ReportProperties.Title: Royal Waste Initiative Fallout

ReportProperties.Description: As part of its initiative to expand global trade, Rizia has signed a contract for the construction of a new cargo plane fleet with Crown Air, based in Jales. This partnership will strengthen economic corridors and expand international logistics capabilities.
ReportProperties.Title: The Sky Silk Road

ReportProperties.Description: The national decree requiring all citizens to invest in the Porte Drazon Stock Exchange has led to widespread public outrage. The forced financial participation has sparked massive protests, with many questioning the fairness of the initiative and its potential long-term impact on their livelihoods.
ReportProperties.Title: Stock Purchase Initiative Backlash

ReportProperties.Description: Rizia's issuance of "Sovereign Bonds," with no repayment plan, has sparked public outrage and fueled mass protests. However, some investors persist in purchasing bonds, relying on the monarchy's proven track record of stability and financial strength.
ReportProperties.Title: Protests Sparked by Sovereign Bonds

ReportProperties.Description: Rizia’s tax on foreign businesses has been met with hostility from international partners, leading several corporations to withdraw from the market. Despite this, the policy remains popular domestically, providing a boost to personal income and improving the standard of living for citizens.
ReportProperties.Title: The People's Dividend

ReportProperties.Description: Rizia has completed scouting locations for tidal generators and settled on a site south of Monqiz to harness ocean energy. While environmentalists have raised concerns about potential impacts on marine life, the project has garnered strong public support for its promise of renewable energy.
ReportProperties.Title: Taming the Tides

ReportProperties.Description: The offer to relocate thousands of loyal Rizian families to Zille resulted in an overwhelming response, forcing authorities to halt applications once capacity limits were reached.
ReportProperties.Title: The Great Resettlement

ReportProperties.Description: Despite concerns about escalating tensions with ATO and CSP, the Intermerkopum mutual defense pact was deemed essential for regional security and received unanimous approval from member nations.
ReportProperties.Title: Intermerkopum Mutual Defense Pact Approval

ReportProperties.Description: Despite some reservations about potential sovereignty risks, the decision to open Intermerkopum membership applications received unanimous approval, primarily driven by the goal of strengthening international alliances and securing Rizia’s position on the global stage.
ReportProperties.Title: Unanimous Approval for Intermerkopum Membership

ReportProperties.Description: The decision to remove dozens of Smolak’s statues and submerge them in the Gulf of Moridia to create artificial reefs has met widespread approval from the Zillian public.
ReportProperties.Title: Smolak Reef Initiative

ReportProperties.Description: In order to address the decades-long atrocities committed by Sordland once and for all, effective immediately, Her Majesty Queen Beatrice Livingston declares that a state of war exists in between the Kingdom of Rumburg and Sordland.
ReportProperties.Title: Proclamation of War

ReportProperties.Description: Queen Beatrice has congratulated us on our victory against Pales, calling it a “turning point for monarchical power in Merkopa”. She added that Rumburg remains committed to standing by Rizia, whatever threats we may face.
ReportProperties.Title: Queen Beatrice Extends Congratulations

ReportProperties.Description: Rumburg closed all diplomatic channels with Sordland and blocked all incoming and outgoing communication. Our intelligence and army reports that the troop movements in the border are indicating a preparation for an invasion.
ReportProperties.Title: Rumburg Closes All Diplomatic Channels

ReportProperties.Description:
A grand ceremony at Arena Sallabes honored the Sazon special divisions for their contributions to our victory in the Pales War.

In particular, Manus Sazon received a medal and the honorary rank of Lieutenant Commander for helping the Sazon forces make it through the conflict with minimal casualties.
ReportProperties.Title: Sazon Heir Hailed As War Hero In Homecoming Ceremony

ReportProperties.Description:
Following the Crown's assumption of control over Brenas, House Sazon has officially relinquished its royal estates and titles.  

Among the adjustments, the fashion house Countess Colors, originally founded by Leona Sazon, has been renamed His Majesty's Colors reflecting its new royal affiliation.
ReportProperties.Title: Brenas Under Crown Authority

ReportProperties.Description:
In response to civil unrest, House Sazon has moved swiftly to reassert control over Brenas. Increased patrols and strategic raids on dissenters have stabilized the region, with Countess Leona Sazon focusing on the importance of unity. 

Reports indicate that disruptions to commerce have been minimal, and city officials are ensuring that order has been fully restored.
ReportProperties.Title: House Sazon Quells Resistance

ReportProperties.Description: Our army’s military engineer corps is overseeing the cleanup of Solles, ensuring that any traces of the nerve gas we unleashed on the city are dealt with and to safeguard the civilian population against possible unintended further exposure.
ReportProperties.Title: Military Engineers Leading Chemical Cleanup

ReportProperties.Description: In a sight reminiscent of the Galmish revolutionary fishing boat parades, the Gulf of Pales has filled with ships waving Rizian, Palesian and House Toras banners to celebrate the newly found unity between our people, turning into a sea of color. Thousands of onlookers gathered at the waterfront in Solles to witness the spectacle.
ReportProperties.Title: Gulf Of Pales Turns Into Sea Of Colour

ReportProperties.Description:
An attempted uprising by Reinhart loyalists, who remained in hiding ever since the war ended, has been successfully defeated by Rizian armed forces still present in the city. The lightly armed group attempted to unsuccessfully seize the harbor, hoping to allow a ship of their exiled comrades to moor.

Unfortunately, our army could not prevent vandals from spraying anti-Rizian graffiti around town amidst the chaos, reading "from the Alca river to the Antacean sea, Pales will be free!". Authorities have commenced a cleanup operation.
ReportProperties.Title: Attempted Uprising Quelled

ReportProperties.Description: The city of Jales has become the latest urban center to be overtaken by the growing protest movement, its noble governors ousted and replaced by a so-called 'revolutionary council'. The recent surge of aggression, marked by the destruction of property and threats to public safety, represents a significant threat to the stability of our kingdom. Our security forces find themselves underequipped and unable to contain the spiralling situation.
ReportProperties.Title: Jales Falls

ReportProperties.Description:
As the Wehzek army continues its march through Bergia, we are receiving reports of increasing casualties due to booby traps and raids by Bludish militants, presumably as an act of revenge for Operation Bear Trap.

The road along Gumren and Oldeburg has also been blocked with a dozen logs, further hindering their progress.
ReportProperties.Title: Roads along Oldeburg and Gumren Blocked

ReportProperties.Description: As unrest in Bergia continues, authorities in Uziren have reported an explosion at the city’s famous market. A homemade bomb appears to have gone off in an area with high foot traffic; the number of casualties is still unknown.
ReportProperties.Title: Explosion at Uziren Market

ReportProperties.Description:
Heavy fighting broke out as Rumburgian soldiers advanced on the defensive positions in Uziren. We have lost 87 soldiers, 2 tanks and 14 warplanes. Rumburg’s attack has been thwarted but the assaults are expected to continue.

Behind the frontline, a special operations team managed to sneak into the enemy territory and demolished the enemy anti-air systems. They were spotted by the enemy and an airstrike struck their position. The situation is expected to deteriorate.
ReportProperties.Title: Uziren War Report

ReportProperties.Description:
Royal FC Valenqir has created an incredible success story, as the club was in third season up until two years ago and has now instantly gone to the top and won the Rizian league. 

For a club that up until two years ago was struggling to fill even half a stadium, the club's meteoric rise is a testament to the successful investments in Rizia’s football industry. The nation now holds its breath to see if the success can continue into next season's Merkopa Cup.
ReportProperties.Title: RFC Valenqir Wins Rizian League

ReportProperties.Description:
House Toras has taken decisive action to quell the unrest in Valenqiris, reinforcing the province's government with additional security measures. 

Authorities have announced the swift removal of rebel agitators to ensure continued stability. Duke Hubertus Toras has assured residents that Valenqiris remains steadfast under his leadership. 

Government services and commerce continue without interruption.
ReportProperties.Title: House Toras Reaffirms Authority

ReportProperties.Description:
With the Crown assuming full control over Valenqiris, governance of the province now rests solely with King Romus Toras. The reigning nobles in Monqiz have relinquished their royal estates and titles, marking the end of their provincial authority.

Emblematic of the restructuring, the Bull's Horns, the House Toras-owned dining establishment on the Monqiz pier, has been replaced with Crown Appetite, a royal restaurant set to redefine the region’s culinary scene.
ReportProperties.Title: Valenqiris Under Direct Royal Rule

ReportProperties.Description: With the election drawing near, our staff at the Maroon Palace has conducted general election polls all across Sordland. Our election polls show that roughly 16% of Sordish citizens would vote for the USP in the upcoming election.
ReportProperties.Title: Election Poll Results

ReportProperties.Description: The Democratic Republic of Valgsland reaffirms its enduring dedication to the alliance with Sordland. The Valgslandian Armed Forces stand ready to defend alongside our allies against any adversity. Should Sordland call upon Valgsland, our nation will respond without delay.
ReportProperties.Title: Valgsland’s Army Stands Ready

ReportProperties.Description: Valgsland's admirals have notified us that two different locations across Rumburg's eastern shores have been selected for amphibious landings. Furthermore, their massive fleet is ready to embark from Wilbern and Sigmort at a moment's notice.
ReportProperties.Title: Valgsland Fleet Prepared To Embark

ReportProperties.Description: Valgish Chancellor Hegel has announced his anger at our Kingdom’s decision to execute Pabel Adria, calling the execution of a ‘working class man’ a symbol of Rizian state repression. The Chancellor invited anyone who was a friend of Pabel to travel to Valgsland, to personally see the difference of how the socialist state treats its workers compared to Rizia.
ReportProperties.Title: Chancellor Hegel Angry At Commonor’s Execution

ReportProperties.Description: The Democratic Republic of Valgsland reaffirms its dedication to fostering peace in Eastern Merkopa. The rising tensions between Rumburg and Sordland must be prevented from escalating further. We strongly urge all parties to exercise restraint and maintain calm in the region.
ReportProperties.Title: Vaglsland Urges Calm

ReportProperties.Description: The Valgslandian officers joined with the Sordish military command to collaborate. Latest reports are indicating that their ships are on their way to blockade Rumburg’s supplies. Marines began their preparations additional military equipment is on its way to support the land troops facing Rumburg.
ReportProperties.Title: Valgsland Army on its Way

ReportProperties.Description:
Rumburg's navy has been spotted patrolling the Markian Sea. Even Sordland’s improved fleet has not been able to keep their ships entirely at bay. Reports of ships sunk in the naval battles are mounting substantially.

Fortunately, the losses are mainly on Rumburg’s side. With the Markian sea primarily under Sordish control, we have managed to sink or capture hundreds of trade ships carrying supplies for Rumburg, some even disguised as civilian boats.
ReportProperties.Title: Rumburg Ships Sunk and Captured in Markian Sea

ReportProperties.Description: Rumburg's navy has been spotted patrolling the Markian Sea. Despite our numerous attempts to assert control over the area, we could not contend with their superior submarine fleet. Hundreds of Sordish trade ships bearing war supplies have consequently been sunk before they could enter our ports.
ReportProperties.Title: Rumburg’s Navy Terrorizing Sordish Trade Ships

ReportProperties.Description:
We have received a communication from President Wiktor Smolak in response to the hostilities faced by the Wehlen army in the Bergia region. In his words: “Wehlen will not fight for a country that despises us.”

He has ordered his army to withdraw from Sordland, and sent an international diplomatic notice to the AN that Wehlen would not be taking part in the war against Rumburg.
ReportProperties.Title: President Smolak Withdraws Army

ReportProperties.Description: The documents have been finalized for our official concession of the territory of Zille to the nation of Wehlen. From henceforth, the Kingdom of Rizia will have no claim on the region. Residents of Rizian heritage will have the option to apply for Wehzek citizenship.
ReportProperties.Title: Zille Permanently Transferred to Wehlen

ReportProperties.Description: The nobles of House Sazon hosted a grand celebration to inaugurate Fedo Square, reinstating the name by which it was known prior to its renaming as Smolak Square under Wehzek rule. There was a parade honoring His Majesty's role in restoring Zille to its original ruling house.
ReportProperties.Title: Smolak Square Renamed

ReportProperties.Description: In the wake of the Zille referendum, thousands of Wehzeks are hastily leaving the region, often leaving possessions and property behind. A true exodus situation has developed at Zille’s harbor, with Wehlen dispatching additional boats to bring back their people.
ReportProperties.Title: Zille Port Sees Exodus Of Wehzeks

ReportProperties.Description: Our army’s military engineer corps is overseeing the cleanup of Ziqes, ensuring that any traces of the nerve gas we unleashed on the city are dealt with and to safeguard the civilian population against possible unintended further exposure.
ReportProperties.Title: Military Engineers Leading Chemical Cleanup

ReportProperties.Description: Following concern by the ethnic Palesian population in Ziqes, a city which is almost 40% Rizian, that the reunification will turn the city into a culturally Rizian one, local authorities have guaranteed that policies will be put into place to ensure the cultural balance of the city is maintained.
ReportProperties.Title: Local Authorities Guarantee Protection Of Palesian Culture

ReportProperties.Description: The newly installed Ziqes major has started promoting the city inside of Rizia, offering homes left by fled Palesians to Rizian citizens for cheap. This effort to change the ethnic makeup of the city has been strongly criticized by Palesians, as it means many will never be able to return to their homes.
ReportProperties.Title: Ethnic Rizians Take Over Empty Homes

ReportProperties.Description: After the King’s speech declaring Rizia a theocracy, secular people, as well as those with non-wruhecist religious beliefs, have been rushing towards Monqiz’s harbor, boarding ships headed to Lespia, Kyrute, Valgsland and Galmland. Those leaving are often of a middle class background and before, as poorer citizens are unable to afford the move abroad.
ReportProperties.Title: Queues At Harbor As People Leave

ReportProperties.Description: Morella has denounced our change towards a theocratic system of government. The country is worried about now being surrounded by religious systems of government on both sides, with Rizia following Derdia and the Free Cities in becoming the next theocracy in the region, and is readying itself to welcome an influx of secularist political refugees from Rizia.
ReportProperties.Title: Morella Worried About Bordering Third Theocracy

ReportProperties.Description: Thousands of worshippers gathered at the Plavo sanctuary to pray for King Romus together, praising our decision for installing a religious system of governments. More worshippers are expected to descend upon the town in weeks to come, with the local economy preparing for record profits.
ReportProperties.Title: Prayers Held At Plavo To Celebrate Religious Government
